question: Which doctors have the highest no-show rates?

output.sql:
SELECT d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_appointments,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'No-Show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_show_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'No-Show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS no_show_rate_pct
FROM appointments a
JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY no_show_rate_pct DESC, no_show_count DESC
LIMIT 100
output.summary: Yasith Jayawardena has the highest no-show rate at 14.67% (55 of 375 appointments), followed by Nadeeka Zoysa at 14.11% and Hashini Fernando at 14.00%. Among the 30 doctors shown (of 100 returned), rates range from 14.67% down to 12.20%, so the differences between doctors are fairly small. Most of these doctors handle roughly 370 to 425 appointments each.
